title: Stenting versus endarterectomy for treatment of carotid-artery stenosis.
author: Brott TG et al.
finding: In this randomized comparison, periprocedural stroke was more common after carotid stenting and myocardial infarction was more common after endarterectomy.

title: Medical Management and Revascularization for Asymptomatic Carotid Stenosis.
author: Brott TG et al.
finding: In these parallel trials of asymptomatic high-grade carotid stenosis, adding stenting or endarterectomy to intensive medical therapy did not have the same effect on the primary outcome.
relevance: A sample carotid trial whose stored full text was checked by the same verifier the digest uses.
